title: Read prices and currencies from a supplier's XML catalogue
examObjective: Converting between output types and data types using DataWeave
basics: An XML element can carry both text and attributes: in `<price currency="EUR">9.50</price>`, the text is `9.50` and `currency` is an attribute. `payload.x.price` reads the text and `payload.x.price.@currency` reads the attribute. Everything read from XML is a String.
prompt:
A supplier sends its catalogue as XML:

```
<catalog><product id="1"><name>Pen</name><price currency="EUR">1.50</price></product></catalog>
```

Return an array of `{ id, name, price, currency }` with `id` and `price` as Numbers. Products that are not priced yet have no `price` element; for those, `price` and `currency` are `null`.
hints: Select every product with `.*product`, and read `id` from the product's attribute.
The currency is an attribute of the `price` element, not of the product.
`null as Number` fails. Coerce the price only when there is one.
solution:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
payload.catalog.*product map {
  id: $.@id as Number,
  name: $.name,
  price: if ($.price == null) null else $.price as Number,
  currency: $.price.@currency
}

mustFail.why: coerces the price unconditionally, which fails on a product that has no price yet
mustFail.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
payload.catalog.*product map {
  id: $.@id as Number,
  name: $.name,
  price: $.price as Number,
  currency: $.price.@currency
}

mustFail.why: reads the currency from the product element, which has no such attribute
mustFail.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
payload.catalog.*product map {
  id: $.@id as Number,
  name: $.name,
  price: if ($.price == null) null else $.price as Number,
  currency: $.@currency
}

explanation.approach: Attributes belong to the element they are written on, so the currency is `$.price.@currency`. Selecting through a missing `price` element gives null for both the text and the attribute, which is what the task wants, but coercing that null to Number fails, so the coercion needs a guard.

snippets.label: Text and attribute of one element
snippets.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
{ text: payload.p.price, cur: payload.p.price.@currency }

snippets.label: A missing element
snippets.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
{ text: payload.p.price, cur: payload.p.price.@currency }
snippets.note: Null, not an error, until you coerce it.
